How to install a PTF build on an ESS environment

Posted on 2020-12-30 | In Procedure

To verify a defect, I have to run mmchrecoverygroup with –active option, but that is only working on an ESS environment after trying different configuration for days.

Prerequisites

  • An ESS environment with existing configuration
  • All nodes in the cluster can mount /u/gpfstest and /u/images

Steps to install a PTF build

  1. Mount /u/gpfstest and /u/images

    # mount -t nfs it2n01:/u/gpfstest /u/gpfstest
# mount -t nfs it2n01:/u/images /u/images

  2. Find the specific PTF image location (e.g. 5.0.5.5 here), extract it.

    # /u/images/SPECTRUM_SCALE/5.0.5_tac505/Spectrum_Scale_Product/PTFS/ptf5/SE_Packages/Daily/latest/x86_64/Spectrum_Scale_Erasure_Code-5.0.5.5-x86_64-Linux-install --silent

  3. Shutdown the GPFS daemon on the node

    # /usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmshutdown

  4. Install the rpm packages

    # /u/gpfstest/GNR/bin/installgnr.sh /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/gpfs_rpms

  5. Startup the GPFS daemon on the node

    # /usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmstartup

  6. Repeat above steps on all the remaining nodes

References

  • (Example) One-line command to install GPFS 5.0.5.5 on one node:

    # mount -t nfs it2n01:/u/gpfstest /u/gpfstest; mount -t nfs it2n01:/u/images /u/images; /u/images/SPECTRUM_SCALE/5.0.5_tac505/Spectrum_Scale_Product/PTFS/ptf5/SE_Packages/Daily/latest/x86_64/Spectrum_Scale_Erasure_Code-5.0.5.5-x86_64-Linux-install --silent; /usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmshutdown; sleep 5; /u/gpfstest/GNR/bin/installgnr.sh /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/gpfs_rpms; sleep 5; /usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmstartup; sleep 10; /usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmgetstate -a

   Cluster installation and protocol deployment
      To install a cluster or deploy protocols with the Spectrum Scale Install Toolkit:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale -h
      To install a cluster manually:  Use the gpfs packages located within /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/gpfs_<rpms/debs>
  
      To upgrade an existing cluster using the Spectrum Scale Install Toolkit:
      1) Copy your old clusterdefinition.txt file to the new /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/configuration/ location
      2) Review and update the config:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale config update
      3) (Optional) Update the toolkit to reflect the current cluster config:
         /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale config populate -N <node>
      4) Run the upgrade:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale upgrade -h
  
      To add nodes to an existing cluster using the Spectrum Scale Install Toolkit:
      1) Add nodes to the clusterdefinition.txt file:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale node add -h
      2) Install GPFS on the new nodes:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale install -h
      3) Deploy protocols on the new nodes:  /usr/lpp/mmfs/5.0.5.5/installer/spectrumscale deploy -h
  
      To update the toolkit to reflect the current cluster config examples:
